text:
lucas: Heads up — seeing a sudden burst of 502/504s across hosted inference in us-east-1 since ~02:10 UTC. Several customers reported timeouts and one escalated to support. Opening thread to triage now.

maya: I see alerts from gateway and auth-proxy. 12 distinct customer sessions with >50% error rate in the window 02:10–02:18. Latency spikes on the auth call chain before the gateway 502s.

emma: Customer-side: multiple tickets complaining of generation timeouts and UI "Something went wrong". Example ticket #CS-4829 — reported at 02:14, attached curl repro. They also saw a billing error modal once.

pranay: Noted — there was a config rollout to auth-proxy at 02:05 to tighten token validation (#deploy 2026-03-auth-v2). Rolling window shows auth validation latency increased right after. Possible correlation.

oliver: Can we get a quick repro? maya, if you have curl from one of the failing requests, paste it here.

maya: Repro (from a failing client):
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://api-hosted.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
* Connected to api-hosted.redwood.ai (52.12.34.56) port 443 (#0)
* TLS handshake complete
> POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1
> Host: api-hosted.redwood.ai
> ...
< HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
< server: nginx
< date: Tue, 17 Mar 2026 02:13:42 GMT
< content-type: application/json
< content-length: 92
<
{"error":"upstream prematurely closed connection","request_id":"rid_0xabc"}
```

pranay: Logs from auth-proxy show repeated timeouts to KMS/token-validator: `WARN token_validator: downstream call timed out after 1000ms` and spikes of 5xx returned as 502 by gateway. KMS call latency jumped to 1.2s for a subset of requests. Might be KMS throttling or new validation logic causing head-of-line blocking.

oliver: If token validation is slow, gateway will surface 502s when backend closes connections. Quick mitigation: 1) rollback the auth-proxy change; or 2) increase token-validator timeout and connection pool; or 3) enable fallback routing to model-variant that bypasses heavy auth path for trusted customers. Which is fastest?

lucas: Rollback is fastest. Pranay, can you revert the 02:05 auth-proxy config? If rollback is risky, increase token-validator timeout and conn pool as an interim.

pranay: I'll prepare a rollback. Patch command ready: `kubectl -n infra set image deploy/auth-proxy auth-proxy=sha256:old` and bump `TOKEN_VALIDATOR_TIMEOUT_MS` from 1000 -> 2500. Applying in 30s if no objections.

emma: Also need comms: reach out to top 5 impacted customers (I have the list) with a note and ETA. Flag billing team — a customer saw a billing modal, might be unrelated but we should confirm.

maya: Quick log snippet from gateway: `ERROR upstream closed connection id=3487 client=52.12.34.56 route=generate status=502 latency=1350ms token_latency=1200ms`. Repro consistent with auth holding things up.

oliver: Agreed on rollback + customer comms. Also capture a sampling of request ids for postmortem; keep raw logs for 72h.

pranay: Rollback started at 02:22 UTC. Patching env var and scaling auth-proxy to 0 then up. Will post status.

sre-bot: Incident note: runbook step `auth-proxy-rollback` initiated by pranay at 02:22:15 UTC.

lucas: After rollback, monitor 502 rate and mean auth validation latency. If it drops below baseline within 5–10m, we can mark mitigation success.

maya: 02:30 checks: error rate dropped from 52% -> 4% for the window, auth latency back to baseline ~120ms. Customer tickets reducing.

emma: I messaged impacted customers and offered status updates. Will follow up with individual resolution notes and potential credit if billing was affected.

oliver: Next steps / action items:
- (pranay) create revert PR and pin the old image + note in deploy docs (due EOD)
- (engineering) add k8s healthcheck to token-validator to avoid head-of-line blocking (owner: maya, due 48h)
- (platform) add circuit-breaker and fallback route for auth timeouts (owner: oliver, due 72h)
- (support) close/triage customer tickets with root-cause explanation (owner: emma, ongoing)
- (postmortem) write a 1-page postmortem and action tracking (owner: lucas, due 3 business days)

lucas: I'll create an incident channel `#incident-3250001234-auth` and assign the postmortem. Please paste any additional logs/req ids here before EOD. Good catch everyone. :thumbsup:

emma: Adding customer ticket IDs: CS-4829, CS-4832, CS-4837 — I'll attach timelines and screenshots to the postmortem doc.

maya: One extra note — add monitoring alert for token-validator p95 > 400ms to avoid future surprises.

pranay: Rollback complete at 02:27 UTC, baseline metrics restored. Leaving this thread open for postmortem items and customer follow-ups.

lucas: Closing triage summary: cause = auth-proxy config change that increased token validation latency causing upstream connection closures -> gateway 502s. Mitigation = rollback + timeout bump. Action owners assigned. Postmortem and customer comms next.
